location: tombstone:construct matrix (removed; was bin/construct matrix→graph alias)
description: REMOVED. `construct matrix` was a deprecated CLI alias for `construct graph` (build/stat/query/validate). Deleted in construct-b0nny.28 / workspace-control-plane E9. Replacement: `construct graph`.

expiration.statedIn: Tombstone retained for audit after removal. Expiration is inert for status:removed entries.

previousExpiration.statedIn: ADR-0053 Decision, CLI naming section: "construct matrix becomes an alias; it emits a deprecation warning and will be removed after 2 release cycles."

extensionHistory.reason: ADR-0053's 2-release-cycle window (since v1.4.2, 2026-07-01) already passed as of 2026-07-17 — 8+ subsequent versions (1.5.0 through 1.5.7) shipped with the alias still present, still emitting only a deprecation warning. Removal is not safe to force from this bead alone: a real functional test (tests/functional/dependency-matrix.functional.test.mjs) invokes `construct matrix build` and asserts exit 0, and CLI catalog/help text (lib/cli-commands.mjs:1351) still documents it. Actual removal is already scoped as a sequenced sibling epic, construct-tsyfe.8 (Legacy Surface Decommissioning): construct-tsyfe.8.1 (discover real-world consumers before removal) gates construct-tsyfe.8.5 (remove once confirmed safe by that discovery); neither has landed yet. Forcing removal here would jump ahead of that discovery step. Extended to 2026-09-01 as a concrete re-review checkpoint — if construct-tsyfe.8.1/8.5 have not landed by then, extend again with a fresh dated reason rather than let this lapse silently.
Surface removed in construct-b0nny.28 / workspace-control-plane E9. Entry retained as an honest tombstone (status:removed); location no longer points at a live handler.
